Ethnicity definition

This page describes how to define ethnicity variables in ehrQL.

Creating variables

Use the codelist_from_csv function to import codelists.

from ehrql.codelist import codelist_from_csv
ethnicity = codelist_from_csv("codelists/ethnicity.csv", column="code")

Then reference the codelist in your dataset definition.

Filtering patients

Filter by ethnicity using the where method.

dataset = dataset.where(ethnicity.is_not_null())
